Masala Chai

Ingredients
- 2 cups water
- 1 cup milk
- 2 teaspoons black tea leaves
- 4 green cardamom pods, crushed
- 1 small piece of ginger, grated
- 2 teaspoons sugar

Method
Boil the water with the cardamom and ginger for 2 minutes. Add the tea leaves and simmer for 1 minute. Add the milk and sugar, bring back to the boil, then strain into cups and serve hot.
